title: Node graph
description: Nodes appear around a hub as you name them, an edge draws from each one to the hub (or along your own links), and small signals keep travelling along the edges into the hub, which fills as more arrive. Every node floats a little. Plain SVG.

props.hi: name of the hub (default: the first node)
props.links: your own edges as pairs of node numbers counted from 0, for example [[1, 0], [2, 0], [2, 3]] (default: every node to the hub)
props.seed: any word or number: another seed, another layout
props.stage: ground colour: a name from STAGE, any colour, or none
